d: A modern take on high performance surfing set in a post-apocalyptic world, reminiscent of Mad Max.
The Rip Curl Pro Search 'Somewhere In Indonesia' with the world's best surfers in the world's best waves.
A mix of high-performance surfing and stunning cinematography documents the search for surfing's holy grail.
Filmed over three years in six countries, Paradigm Lost captures the highest level of water sports action.

t: Archy: Built for Speed, Born to Ride
d: Matt Archbold's story is one of survival through early surf stardom and the surf rock star lifestyle.
An exploration of sound and pro-surf, conjuring a symbiosis of music, the environment and local culture.
